text:
The easy shortcut for any writer is to mention a topic in passing so that it looks covered. In TextOS, a statement that cites no source does not count as covering a required point, even when it talks about the right topic. Naming a subject is not the same as backing it up.

A required point can still be left out on purpose: when a person has accepted the reason for excluding it, the draft can pass without it. A gap that someone chose and explained is treated differently from a gap nobody noticed. Structure is checked as well: if a section the brief requires is missing, the draft is blocked.
